COOKIES & TRACKING

A small, honest
tracking notice.

The website currently uses a Google Analytics tag and does not add a custom cookie-preference control. Confirm consent requirements before relying on analytics in production.

What the site currently does

The generated pages include the configured Google Analytics measurement tag. The site does not create its own project-detail storage or advertising-cookie system.

What needs confirmation

The business should confirm the lawful basis, consent approach, regional requirements, retention settings and whether analytics should load before or after a visitor choice. A functional preference control should be added if consent is required.

Third parties

Analytics processing is subject to the provider’s terms and privacy documentation. No additional advertising or remarketing service is configured in this implementation.
